rows.details: G. B. Pant National Institute of Himalayan Environment (GBPNIHE)
In house project-02: "Resilience Building in Climate - Sensitive Basins in the Indian Himalayan Region- Mapping Vulnerable Hotspots and Communities for Risk Reduction and Adaptation"

content_sections.heading: About GBPNIHE
content_sections.text: G. B. Pant National Institute of Himalayan Environment (GBPNIHE) is located at Kosi-Katarmal, Almora, Uttarakhand. This notice is for a project-based temporary position in its in-house project-02, which deals with mapping vulnerable hotspots and communities in climate-sensitive basins of the Indian Himalayan Region. Applications are invited only from Indian citizens.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The essential qualification for the Field Assistant post is graduation from any subject. The notice also asks for consistently good academic records and experience in the relevant subject or specialization. The age limit is 50 years; the notice prints no cut-off date for counting age and no age relaxation. Preference will be given to candidates with experience in field data collection in the Himalayan regions. Knowledge of computer (MS Office, Internet) and official work. Experience in soil / water / air quality monitoring and analysis. Experience will not be considered without an experience certificate. The minimum qualification and/or experience can be relaxed for exceptionally outstanding candidates. Meeting the minimum qualification does not automatically entitle a candidate to be called for the interview or test. Candidates should therefore mention all qualifications and experience in the relevant field beyond the minimum, supported with documents.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Field Assistant is paid Rs. 18,000/- fixed. The engagement is purely temporary and project based. The notice does not state its length. The Institute may disengage the manpower at any time without assigning any reason. The selected candidate is expected to join immediately and is liable to be posted anywhere in India.

content_sections.heading: GBPNIHE Field Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: Assisting officials for entry of records, baseline data generation and field work at the Indian Himalayan Region. Any other scientific/technical jobs that may be assigned from time to time.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GBPNIHE Field Assistant
content_sections.text: Submit the application on the online recruitment portal, https://gbpihed.gov.in/vacancy.php , on or before 11:59 PM on 2 December 2026. Mention in the application all qualifications and experience in the relevant field, over and above the minimum, supported with documents. Attend the walk-in interview on 4 December 2026 from 10:00 am onwards at GBPNIHE, Kosi-Katarmal, Almora (Uttarakhand). The interview is for candidates who have completed the online application form. Original documents of educational qualifications and experience, with one set of photocopies, to be brought to the interview. Experience certificate; experience is not considered without it.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates who have completed the online application form are called for a physical walk-in interview on 4 December 2026. If many applications are received, the Institute reserves the right to raise the minimum eligibility level to restrict the number of candidates called for interview or test, in line with the number of vacancies. The Institute may also shortlist and select candidates for any suitable position depending on the qualification and experience required for the post.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview. The Institute reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of positions and to fill or not fill any or all posts. Canvassing in any form is treated as disqualification. The Institute's decision on eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, mode of selection and conduct of interview is final, and no query or correspondence from any individual or agency is entertained.

faq.question: Q1. How many Field Assistant posts are there in GBPNIHE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 Field Assistant post (Post Code HQ 26-27 -2701) in in-house project-02 at GBPNIHE, Kosi-Katarmal, Almora.
